Question of the week: What are our Jays building in the maker space this week? Scroll to the end for the answer!

A NOTE FROM BEN

Dear Helios Families,

It is really quiet at the campsite this morning. Camping with the students is one of the parts of this job I treasure most: the communal cooking, the board games after dark, and the teachers in their casual interactions with the students.

Thank you to the parent chaperones who took time out of their weeks, and to Karn, our camping coordinator, for another fall season. If you would like to be involved next spring, contact Karn.

Yours, Ben

ANNOUNCEMENTS & REMINDERS

Virtual Math Back to School Afternoon: Thursday, 9/17

On Thursday, 9/17, from 1:30 to 2:30pm, we host a virtual, math-specific Back to School Afternoon. Meet your child's math teacher, hear about the plans for the year, and ask any general questions about the class. The link will be sent to your Helios email address a few days before.

Picture Day: Tuesday, 9/22

Picture day is Tuesday, 9/22. Order forms go home in backpacks on Monday.

HCA NEWSLETTER

Join us at International Night: Layers of Our Community (September 24)

Join us on Thursday, September 24, 2026, from 4:00 to 6:00 PM at the sixth annual International Night. Our map currently contains: China, India, Italy, Japan, Norway, the Philippines and Vietnam.

Can you join a booth or start a new one? Sign up here. A booth entails some combination of a poster, some food from that region, and optionally an activity or a performance on our rolling stage. Parents, staff and students welcome!

Mark These Upcoming HCA Dates

  • Saturday, 9/19: Fondue & Fort Night: fancy fondue and fancy forts, for kids and adults
  • Sunday, 9/20 at 6:00pm: Book Club at Linden Tree
  • Thursday, 9/24 at 4:00pm: International Night. Help needed!
  • Saturday, 9/26: Pickleball!

LIBRARY CORNER

Hello Helios, and welcome to the Library! Jays are listening to a story about a young goatherd who sets off to rescue her best friend, a turtle, from a horrible fate. Author visit this coming Monday!

Love and books, Elizabeth

Answer of the week: Marble runs, and one of them reaches the ceiling.
